evidence.reason: The shown `GitLedger.git` wrapper invokes Git without `--no-replace-objects`, and `GitLedger.read` uses that wrapper for `rev-list` and `diff-tree`, so a local `refs/replace` entry can substitute the commit graph/tree used to validate ledger records. That is a concrete integrity bypass of the ledger reader; the global flag is the minimal compatible repair. The trigger requires local ref-write access, so it is minor, and the separate `fetch` ancestry helper is outside the supplied region, but the wrapper itself is already defective.
